# Vendored dependencies

All dependencies are committed here so OcclusaCAD builds offline and reproducibly. Every one uses a permissive license compatible with OcclusaCAD's AGPL-3.0 (Apache-2.0 is compatible with the GPLv3 family).

| Directory | Project | Version | License | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `imgui/` | [Dear ImGui](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui) (docking branch) | 1.92.9 | MIT | UI framework, GLFW/OpenGL3 backends |
| `imguizmo/` | [ImGuizmo](https://github.com/CedricGuillemet/ImGuizmo) | master @ 18cef5e (2026-08-08) | MIT | 3D manipulation gizmo |
| `glfw/` | [GLFW](https://www.glfw.org/) | 3.4 | zlib | Windowing, input, OpenGL context |
| `glad/` | OpenGL loader generated by [glad 2](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad) (taken from GLFW 3.4 `deps/`) | GL 3.3 | Public domain / CC0 (generated code); Khronos headers MIT-style | OpenGL function loading |
| `glm/` | [GLM](https://github.com/g-truc/glm) | 1.0.3 | MIT (or Happy Bunny) | Vector/matrix math |
| `sqlite3/` | [SQLite](https://sqlite.org) amalgamation | 3.53.4 | Public domain | Case database |
| `nfd/` | [nativefiledialog-extended](https://github.com/btzy/nativefiledialog-extended) | 1.4.1 | zlib | Native file/folder dialogs (Win32, Cocoa, XDG portal) |
| `nfd/3ps/wayland-protocols/` | xdg-foreign protocol XML from [wayland-protocols](https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/wayland/wayland-protocols) | main | MIT | nfd Wayland parent windows |
| `nlohmann/` | [nlohmann/json](https://github.com/nlohmann/json) | 3.12.0 | MIT | Config and design-state JSON |
| `doctest/` | [doctest](https://github.com/doctest/doctest) | 2.5.3 | MIT | Unit tests |
| `stb/` | [stb_image_write](https://github.com/nothings/stb) | master | MIT / public domain | PNG screenshots |
| `manifold/` | [Manifold](https://github.com/elalish/manifold) (core only: `include/`, `src/`; no 2D cross sections, serial backend) | 3.5.4 | Apache-2.0 | Robust mesh Booleans (merging bridge units and connectors) |
| `fonts/` | [Inter](https://rsms.me/inter/) Regular and SemiBold | 4.1 | SIL OFL 1.1 | UI typeface (embedded in the binaries) |

Only the files needed for the build were copied: no upstream examples, tests or docs. Each directory keeps the upstream license file, or the license is in the header for single-header libraries.

## Updating

Replace the directory contents with the new upstream release, keep the license file, and update this table. `third_party/CMakeLists.txt` defines how each library is built. GLFW and nfd use their own CMake projects, configured with tests, examples and installation turned off.
